goal: Edge case review: empty, maximum, duplicate, invalid and concurrent inputs.
use: Edge case review: empty, maximum, duplicate, invalid and concurrent inputs. Use when a function or endpoint handles input from outside.

steps.note: List inputs. Name each parameter and where it comes from.
Check empty and null. Note how each handles nothing.
Check limits. Note behaviour at zero, one and the maximum.
Check invalid and duplicate. Note behaviour for bad or repeated input.
Report. Each input with the unhandled case, file and line, and the fix.
